name: rtl433
description: Short-range device decoders (433 / 868 / 915 MHz): weather stations, tyre-pressure sensors (TPMS), remote controls, door and alarm sensors, energy and water meters. 384 rtl_433 decoders, receive only, standard input only.

privacy.hide_ids_note: --hide-ids replaces every identifier field (id, ids, *_id, serial, address, ...) by a short salted hash (hNNNNNNNN) that is stable for one run, and drops raw payload fields (data, payload, raw, bits ...). The salt is random per run unless --hide-ids-salt is given.

not_built: Itron ERT SCM, SCM+, IDM, NetIDM (patent US7830874, shown active to 2029-02-09)
LoRa chirp demodulation and the LoRa / LoRaWAN decoders (Cotech 36-9231, LoRaWAN frames, ELSYS ERS)
decoders that decrypt their payload or recover a key (IKEA Sparsnas, Govee H5059 / H5112 / H5310, Apator Metra ERM30 / EITN30, ELV ESA / Gira EHZ): rule 'no decryption, no key recovery'
radio drivers (RTL-SDR, SoapySDR, rtl_tcp), network outputs (MQTT, InfluxDB, HTTP, syslog, UDP), signal-file writers, pulse analyser (replay aids)
